hits.about: West Bay Tower is a luxury residential complex, apartments in which fäm Master Agency offers for purchase, located in the Business Bay area of Dubai. The 34-storey building is being erected by the developer Orion Real Estate Development. This residential complex has all conditions for a comfortable life and profitable investment.West Bay Tower is a stunning architectural design, including 252 residences for every taste: studios, apartments with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms. The apartments are carefully planned to maximize the cosmopolitan lifestyle. They create a warm and positive atmosphere both inside and outside. The best materials were used in construction, and quality finishes and partially equipped kitchens will minimize costs and ensure the fastest and most comfortable move-in and stay in the complex.Among the amenities of the complex should be noted walking and barbecue area, spa, swimming pool on the roof of the building, well-equipped gym. Security is provided by a 24-hour video surveillance system, and a sufficient number of parking spaces is also an advantage for choosing West Bay Tower as a place for comfortable living. The complex overlooks the Dubai Water Canal and is surrounded by many business and financial institutions.The luxurious building offers many advantages for living in the city center. The complex is located within walking distance of Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain and Dubai Mall.
hits.title: West Bay Tower
